findings.title: Block Public Access is not fully enforced
findings.description: One or more Block Public Access protections are disabled for the bucket.
findings.recommendation: Enable all Block Public Access settings for the bucket.

findings.title: No bucket policy is attached
findings.description: The bucket does not currently have a bucket policy.
findings.recommendation: Continue to audit future bucket policy changes.

findings.title: Unable to review bucket ACL
findings.description: The scanner could not retrieve the bucket ACL from AWS.

evidence.error_message: An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the GetBucketAcl operation: User: arn:aws:iam::799517333938:user/s3-auditor is not authorized to perform: s3:GetBucketAcl on resource: "arn:aws:s3:::s3-audit-private-deepak-2026" because no identity-based policy allows the s3:GetBucketAcl action

findings.recommendation: Verify IAM access and bucket existence before interpreting the ACL result.

findings.title: Default encryption is enabled
findings.description: The bucket has a default encryption rule configured.
findings.recommendation: Continue to review whether SSE-S3 or SSE-KMS fits the security requirement.

findings.title: Versioning is disabled
findings.description: The bucket does not currently have versioning enabled.
findings.recommendation: Enable versioning to preserve previous object versions and improve recovery options.

findings.title: Server access logging is not enabled
findings.description: The bucket does not have S3 server access logging configured.
findings.recommendation: Configure server access logging to a dedicated logging bucket to record access events.

findings.title: Unable to verify ownership controls
findings.description: The scanner encountered a client-side or AWS-side issue while retrieving ownership controls.

evidence.error_message: An error occurred (AccessDenied) when calling the GetBucketOwnershipControls operation: User: arn:aws:iam::799517333938:user/s3-auditor is not authorized to perform: s3:GetBucketOwnershipControls on resource: "arn:aws:s3:::s3-audit-private-deepak-2026" because no identity-based policy allows the s3:GetBucketOwnershipControls action

findings.recommendation: Verify bucket region, permissions, and AWS API availability before relying on the result.

findings.title: Bucket policy does not enforce HTTPS
findings.description: No bucket policy exists, so there is no HTTPS enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Add a bucket policy with a Deny statement for aws:SecureTransport == false.
